rawContent: As we near the 5th anniversary of #EricGarner’s killing join us, @MomsRising, @watchthecops, @nyjusticeleague, + others on Mon, July 15, at 2pm ET for a tweetstorm to demand @NYCMayor #FirePantaleo immediately! Eric’s life mattered. His family deserves justice. #BlackLivesMatter

Saying #BlackLivesMatter without taking action to reflect that is the WORST. For five long years #EricGarner’s family has gone without justice. @NYCMayor & NYPD must take action & #FirePantaleo & ALL officers involved in his killing NOW!

When this lack of respect for human life by sworn public servants goes undisciplined, it paves the way for further injustice, abuse, discrimination, violence, killing. If #BlackLivesMatter @NYCmayor, NYPD MUST #FirePantaleo & #FireNYPD officers involved in #EricGarner's killing.
“We live in a city where we say #BlackLivesMatter but we do not act like Black lives matter.” @bradlander #FirePantaleo https://t.co/XBSuvJlU3d

5 yrs of lies.
5 yrs of inaction.
5 yrs of protecting cops who kill.
5 yrs of blaming the victim.
5 yrs passing the buck.
5 yrs of cowardice.
5 yrs of saying “#BlackLivesMatter” but not acting like it.
Today we say not 1 day more.
4pm Foley Sq.
#EricGarner
#FirePantaleo
#FireNYPD
